controls.input_condition: An HSE row contains both annual emissions target and actual annual emissions
controls.expected_action: Store target_tco2e and actual_emissions_tco2e in separate fields and calculate variance explicitly
controls.risk_prevented: Treating a regulatory target as measured emissions

controls.input_condition: An installation is present in HSE data and an allocation dataset
controls.expected_action: Do not substitute free allowances or allocation values for actual emissions; reconcile status and scheme period first
controls.risk_prevented: Converting an entitlement into an emissions measurement

controls.input_condition: A UK ETS allocation table cell contains an allowance quantity
controls.expected_action: Classify the value as UKA/free_allocation_units, not measured_tco2e, unless a separate verified emissions field exists

controls.input_condition: A 2026 Standard or NER component is blank while the Total column contains a value
controls.expected_action: Preserve the component as under_review_or_not_populated; do not coerce the blank to zero
controls.risk_prevented: False zero allocations and broken totals

controls.input_condition: The allocation table is revised after an Activity Level Change update
controls.expected_action: Pin publication date and version; supersede prior rows through an explicit revision relationship

controls.input_condition: Installation names vary between HSE, allocation or PRTR sources
controls.expected_action: Match using installation identifier where available plus normalized name, regulator, reporting period and location context; retain unmatched state when ambiguous
controls.risk_prevented: False joins between similarly named installations

controls.input_condition: A target or actual-emissions year is absent, not yet published or not applicable
controls.expected_action: Keep the value null with a reason code; never replace it with numeric zero

controls.input_condition: The same installation appears across 2021-2025 and 2026-2030 status lists
controls.expected_action: Store status by allocation_period and effective dates; do not carry HSE status across periods automatically

controls.input_condition: A non-hospital installation is assessed for HSE eligibility
controls.expected_action: Evaluate reportable emissions and rated thermal input as separate conditions, including the applicable scheme-year evidence
controls.risk_prevented: Qualifying an installation from only one threshold

controls.input_condition: An ultra-small emitter reaches or exceeds the agreed 2500 tCO2e threshold
controls.expected_action: Flag threshold_exceeded, preserve monitoring data and trigger regulator-notification workflow
controls.risk_prevented: Continuing invalid USE treatment after threshold breach

controls.input_condition: A PRTR release carries M, C, E, U or a detailed methodology code
controls.expected_action: Persist the original method code and map measured, calculated, estimated and unspecified into separate categories
controls.risk_prevented: Presenting estimates or calculations as direct measurements

controls.input_condition: PRTR rows are combined across facilities, pollutants or reporting years
controls.expected_action: Require facility identity, reporting year, pollutant, receiving medium and unit before aggregation
controls.risk_prevented: Cross-pollutant, cross-year or cross-facility aggregation errors
